prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Deus ama quem dá com alegria.

meta.face: A young deacon around 25, slightly older-looking than a boy, short dark hair with a small clerical tonsure, the first light shadow of a beard on the jaw, serene upward gaze.
meta.basis: Young with a budding beard, a little older than Stephen, as the Painter's Manual distinguishes the two deacons; gridiron, palm, dalmatic and Gospel book.

sources.title: Dionysius of Fourna, The Painter's Manual (Hermeneia), c. 1730 — Didron's 1845 French edition

history.note: New card generated with the Cecilia, Dominic and Moses the Black cards as style references
Gridiron redrawn twice until it read as a grill lying flat
Face edited to separate him from Stephen
